licence_note: CAMELS-US streamflow originates from USGS NWIS (public domain); forcing is Daymet basin means as distributed by CAMELS.
access: read-only local copy; no network access during extraction

units.prcp_hundredths_mm: Daymet basin-mean precipitation in hundredths of a mm/day (integer; the file has two decimals)
units.tmean_halfdeg_bin_on_wet_days: floor(tmax + tmin) = floor(2 * mean temperature): the half-degree bin of the daily mean temperature (C), only for days with prcp > 0, in date order; for a threshold T that is a multiple of 0.5, mean < T is exactly bin < 2 * T
units.monthly_hundredths_mm: monthly precipitation totals in hundredths of a mm, water-year order Oct..Sep, WY1990..WY2009

notes: tmean_halfdeg_bin_on_wet_days holds one value per day with prcp > 0, in date order; the matching days are the nonzero entries of prcp_hundredths_mm.
Monthly totals are sums of the daily Daymet basin-mean values over each calendar month; day counts per month are in monthly_days.
CAMELS attributes are copied as distributed (camels_clim.txt: p_mean, frac_snow, high_prec_freq, high_prec_dur, low_prec_freq).
